evidence.reason: At the current tip, `run()` still collapses any `None` returned by `drain()` into `{'status': 'drained'}` and exits 0. Early automatic skips (fetch failure or tick-lock contention) therefore produce the same JSON as a completed pass, so a JSON-only caller cannot tell that no inbox work ran. The surrounding code already uses structured `paused`, `busy`, and `deferred` results for comparable conditions; this is an ordinary reporting bug, not a request for a new contract requirement.
